brand.description: The brand name. Inferred from the site when empty.

competitors.description: Competitor names or domains. The model picks the main ones when empty.

count.description: How many prompts to suggest, at most 50.

description.description: What the product does and who it is for. Inferred from the site when empty.

domain.description: The site to suggest prompts for, for example posthog.com. The model reads it with web search.

topics.description: Topics to spread the prompts across. The model picks 3 to 6 when empty.
